description: Get the real online booking link for a veterinary clinic so the user can book an appointment on the clinic's own website. Use when the user wants to book, schedule, or make an appointment with a vet. Returns the clinic's online booking page (for example its PetDesk or Vetstoria scheduler) when one can be found, otherwise the clinic's contact page and phone number. This tool does NOT complete the booking itself — it hands the user off to the clinic's site, where they finish booking. Read-only.

location.description: City or area, used with name when place_id is unknown.

name.description: Clinic name, used with location when place_id is unknown.

place_id.description: The clinic's place_id from find_vets or find_emergency_vet. Preferred.

name: book_appointment
